entries.name: p_EntityCpntHitPoint_OnGainHealthEvent

entries.note: [proposed run3-kit/drcov] Called exclusively by 0x140827100; computes directional + radial knockback vector from hit origin/forward, directional/radial strength, and inverse-square distance falloff.

entries.name: p_HitPoint_DispatchPostHealListeners

entries.name: p_HitPoint_DispatchPreHealModifiers
entries.note: [proposed run3-kit/drcov] Called by 0x140820a90 and 0x140821470; dispatches pre-heal modifier signal channel (this+0x68) with (&healAmount, &sourceTag) and safe deferred removal.

entries.name: p_EntityCpntHittable_RegisterNamedEventThunk
